get.description: Returns the readiness state of the video provider and every configured ad platform. The probe performs a real Pollo auth-key ping and a transport-level reachability check for each platform; in mock mode every component is reported as ready with is_mock=true.
Pings the database and returns 200 with status=ok when reachable, or 503 with a diagnostic payload when not. Intended for Kubernetes liveness/readiness probes.

Serves docs/swagger.json (the file produced by `swag init`) under the conventional /openapi.json path. Returns 404 with a remediation hint when the spec is missing so operators do not silently serve a stale document.
